summary: Investigated why a grep took 2 minutes (the prior shell walked ~/.pi caches/node_modules) and then diagnosed a 'Error from provider (Console Go): Upstream request failed: Endpoint is unavailable' error encountered when using the git 'Commit all' flow. Identified the session as using the opencode-go provider (opencode.ai/zen/go/v1), whose upstream relay returned a transient 503; a recheck of /v1/models returned 200, so the outage cleared.
decisions: Abandon broad `grep` over `~/.pi` and instead target known config files (models.json, auth.json, settings.json) and the pi-coding-agent package directory to keep searches fast.
Treat the 'Console Go' 503 as originating from the opencode-go model's upstream relay rather than a local bug, since the string 'Console Go' does not appear in any local config, source, or registry.

Diagnose the failing commit flow as: git extension 'Commit all' → generateCommitMessage LLM call → opencode-go relay 503 → exception thrown before the commit dialog opens, blocking the user from typing a message manually.
errors: Prior shell `grep` over ~/.pi took ~2 minutes because it traversed caches, node_modules, and session logs — switched to targeted checks afterward.

Commit 'Commit all' flow threw 'Error from provider (Console Go): Upstream request failed: Endpoint is unavailable.' (HTTP 503 from opencode.ai/zen/go/v1 upstream). Confirmed transient — a follow-up curl to https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/models returned 200.
